title: Corrected QT Interval (QTc)
sources: AHA/ACCF/HRS 2009 recommendations for standardization of the ECG
purpose: Checked before/after any QT-prolonging drug (ondansetron, droperidol, haloperidol, methadone, antipsychotics) — directly changes med choice.

interpretation.label: Borderline / prolonged — review QT-prolonging meds and electrolytes
Markedly prolonged — high torsades risk; avoid adding QT-prolonging drugs

notes: Normal threshold is < 440 ms (men) / < 460 ms (women). Fridericia is more accurate at extremes of heart rate; prefer it for HR < 60 or > 100.
buildNote: Formula engine. Fridericia uses a cube root — verify the app's expression evaluator supports cbrt().
